cover.report_type: Seven days before a primary election

_meta.notes: FORM GOVERNS AND AGREES WITH THE CHUNK FILE ON SUBSTANCE: cover Office 'COUNTY COUNCIL', Office Sought 'County Council', District Number '6', party 'Democrat', signature date 6/22/20, form title '2020 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate'. CHUNK FLAG CONFIRMED: the clerk listing label 'June 2020' is a listing label; the form's own checked Type-of-Report box is INTERIM / 'Seven days before a primary election' (X through the box, every other box empty), and that is what reporting_period should carry. THE FILER'S NAME IS SPELLED TWO WAYS ON THE SAME COVER and a third way inside: 'Aaron De Keyzer' (Name of Candidate, cursive, spaced) and 'AARON DEKEYZER' (Report Verification print-name line, all caps, unspaced); the page-header 'Candidate or Officeholder's Last Name' box alternates too - 'De Keyzer' on pages 3, 4, 6 and 'DEKEYZER' on pages 2, 5, 7. Schedule A p5 line 32 prints the contributor as 'AARON DEKEYZER'. All are transcribed VERBATIM as printed and none is normalized. Amendment question: NEITHER the 'Yes' NOR the 'No' box is checked - is_amendment is honestly blank. PAGES 8-10 ARE THE 'OTHER CAMPAIGN ACCOUNTS' FAMILY AND ARE DELIBERATELY NOT MERGED INTO THE SCHEDULE A/B ROWS: p8 is the 'Summary Page Other Campaign Accounts' whose Column B header is 'Year to Date' (a DIFFERENT table from the standard Summary Page, never interchangeable), and all seven of its lines carry a hand-drawn zero glyph; p9 'Itemized Contributions from Other Campaign Accounts' and p10 'Itemized Expenditures from Other Campaign Accounts' each carry a single hand-written 'N/A' in the first name cell, no transactions, and a zero glyph in both the SUBTOTAL and TOTAL cells. Zero rows are emitted from pages 9-10, and the 'N/A' is not a transaction. TWO FILER CORRECTIONS ARE ON THE PAGE AND ARE RETAINED, NEVER RECONCILED: the Schedule B TOTAL cell on p6 and p7 each hold struck-through earlier attempts (5,264.45, then 5,296.57), superseded by the un-struck 5,346.57 written below the table on both pages; and p7's struck page subtotal 4,102.22 is this page's sum minus its last row. PRIVACY: the county's black bar covers the whole Complete Mailing Address column on Schedule A pages 3, 4 and 5, plus the cover's street/city/state/ZIP block, the cover's phone/fax/email block and the signature - so donor_city and donor_state are blank as 'redacted at source' on every row, a different fact from a filer leaving them empty. THE BAR UNDER-COVERS IN TWO PLACES ON PAGE 3 (a sliver of address ink is visible above the bar's top edge on row 1, and the bar breaks into two rectangles leaving a narrow horizontal gap between rows 10 and 11); nothing was read out of, or written from, either sliver - this is a finding about slco.org's redaction, consistent with the classes already recorded in PRIVACY.md, not about this dataset. Occupation/Employer survives unredacted on every Schedule A row and is captured verbatim, two-line cells joined with ' / '. Cents on the Schedule A pages are largely written as a raised superscript over a rule; transcribed with a decimal point.

contributions.detail: 32 rows over pages 3-5 sum to 5,170.00 = the three printed page subtotals (1,115.00 + 1,955.00 + 2,100.00) = the printed TOTAL CONTRIBUTIONS RECEIVED 5,170.00 (repeated on all three pages) = Summary line 1 Column A 5,170.00 = Summary line 4. SCOPE TESTED per the brief: the schedule grand total equals Column A (period), NOT Column B (7,850.19 aggregate), so the two printed anchors share one scope and either gates. No in-kind rows are marked anywhere on this Schedule A, so no schedule-total-vs-summary-gap arises.

expenditures.detail: 28 rows over pages 6-7 sum to 5,346.57 = the two printed page subtotals (1,212.23 + 4,134.34) = the filer's final handwritten grand total 5,346.57 written below the table on both pages = Summary line 2 Column A 5,346.57 = Summary line 6. SCOPE TESTED: the schedule grand total equals Column A (period), not Column B (6,313.85). The printed TOTAL cells on both pages hold two EARLIER, struck-through attempts (5,264.45 and 5,296.57); the operative figure is the un-struck 5,346.57 below the table, and it is the one that agrees with the Summary Page.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: ALL FIVE SCHEDULE PAGES GATE. p3 rows 1,115.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 1,115.00. p4 rows 1,955.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 1,955.00. p5 rows 2,100.00 = printed SUBTOTAL 2,100.00. p6 rows 1,212.23 = printed SUBTOTAL 1,212.23 (printed with a decimal COMMA, '1,212,23', in the Purpose column, beside a struck-through earlier figure '1,162.23' in the amount cell) - THIS GATE DECIDED A DIGIT, see escalation_note. p7 rows 4,134.34 = printed SUBTOTAL 4,134.34 (beside a struck-through '4,102.22', which is exactly this page's sum WITHOUT its last row - an independent confirmation that all 14 p7 rows were read correctly and that the filer totalled before adding the final Go Daddy line).
itemized.escalation_note: THE DECIDING ESCALATION, p6 row 6 (VANTIV, FUNDS DIST. FEE): the leading digit is a heavily overwritten glyph legible as either 6 or 8 at 200, 600 and 1200 dpi - a tight 1200 dpi cell crop did NOT settle it. The document's arithmetic did: the other 13 p6 amounts (each confirmed in 600 dpi column crops) sum to 1,130.50, and the printed page subtotal is 1,212.23, forcing this cell to 81.73. That subtotal is itself triply corroborated - 1,212.23 + p7's exactly-gating 4,134.34 = 5,346.57 = the filer's final handwritten grand total = Summary line 2 Column A = Summary line 6. Recorded as 81.73 per the standing rule that the form's own sum outranks any glyph re-read at any resolution (the Rhodes reversal). Other escalations: p3 amount column in two 600 dpi strips; p3 row 9 date at 1200 dpi (see that row's note); p3 row 9 name at 1200 dpi (unresolved, kept low); p3 rows 10 and 11 date/name at 600 dpi; p3 row 1 Occupation cell at 600 dpi (resolved 'OIG-Fed Housing Finance'); p4 rows 1, 3, 9, 12 at 600 dpi and rows 3, 12 again at 1200 dpi; p6 amount column in two 600 dpi strips; p6 and p7 subtotal/total blocks at 600 dpi; p2 Summary block at 600 dpi.
